name: McLaren P1 GTR (2015)
model_credit: "McLaren P1 GTR 2015" (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/mclaren-p1-gtr-2015-187bdc110d16417e8a02e71af4ebd8d8) by LC Design, CC-BY-4.0

mclaren_orange.description: McLaren Orange metallic body, gloss black accents, exposed black carbon splitter, side skirts, diffuser and wing, gloss black 10-spoke centre-lock wheels on Pirelli slicks, black calipers (the only caliper option on the real GTR), swoosh LED headlamps, full-width rear LED bar.

satin_grey.description: Satin metallic gunmetal-grey body over the whole car including the bonnet (no stripes), exposed black carbon lower parts and wing, gloss black 10-spoke wheels, red brake calipers (from the user's reference photo).

burton_blue.description: Burton Blue (solid) body with a white stripe, black calipers. Real car: chassis 023. Source: https://backoffice.rmsothebys.com/auctions/mi25/lots/r0031-2015-mclaren-p1-gtr/
burton_blue.evidence: RM Sotheby's identifies chassis 023 as Burton Blue with a white stripe; finish and hex are visual estimates, caliper colour undocumented.

iridium_blue.description: Iridium Blue (pearl) body, satin-black accents, black calipers. Real car: chassis 014 (later wrapped in a similar metallic blue). Source: https://backoffice.rmsothebys.com/auctions/lf25/lots/r0053-2015-mclaren-p1-gtr/
iridium_blue.evidence: Chassis 014 was specified in Iridium Blue; the listing shows a later metallic-blue wrap, so the hex approximates the wrap; caliper colour undocumented.

geneva_launch_yellow_green.description: Geneva 2015 launch livery: yellow body with green accents (tribute to the 1995 F1 GTR 06R), black calipers. Source: https://www.completecar.ie/car-news/article/4449/McLaren-P1-GTR-sports-new-livery
geneva_launch_yellow_green.evidence: The 2015 Geneva car wore a yellow-and-green livery inspired by F1 GTR chassis 06R; paint names, finish and hex are visual estimates.

james_hunt_tribute.description: James Hunt 40th anniversary tribute: black body with red accents (the real car also has yellow and blue stripes), black calipers. Source: https://drivemag.com/news/mclaren-paints-p1-gtr-in-james-hunt-s-race-colors/
james_hunt_tribute.evidence: McLaren's Hunt tribute uses a black base with red, yellow and blue stripes; only red is modelled as the accent colour.

senna_tribute_white.description: MSO Ayrton Senna tribute: Anniversary White body with Rocket Red accents, black calipers. Source: https://www.sx-z.com/mso-creates-unique-mclaren-p1-gtr-to-celebrate-to-ayrton-senna/
senna_tribute_white.evidence: The MSO 'Beco' tribute combines Anniversary White with McLaren Rocket Red; finish and hex are visual estimates.
